_about: Player-type tags from karma's reads (21 Nov 2026), display only. See the project doc claude/archetype-matchup-idea-2026-11-21.md. 'rim runner' = REB is the bet, PTS volatile; 'bag big' = has his own post/face-up/shooting, PTS is the bet; 'tall skilled big' = 7'+ with a bag, edge vs small or weak-rim bigs; 'physical forward' = edge vs OKC-style small switching defences; 'downhill creator' = young handler/attacker, edge vs OKC. Add tags as karma calls them or the play-by-play tagging backtest confirms them.
